node.title: Re^3: What is the meaning of this line in Perl on linux?
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:
No. The above line is a syntax error and Perl tells you so.

Maybe you want to learn about Perl quoting rules for strings? The backslash \ is special in Perl strings and is used to mark the next character as exempt from the quoting rules. See [https://perldoc.perl.org/perlop#Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators|Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators], especially the section about Escape Sequences. There it explains why you need to write \\ when you want to match a single \ in a regular expression.
